propositions: When enforce_plan_material_pins is true, pin drift, missing pinned targets, or malformed pin records invalidate plan-review attestations and prevent claim consumption, idempotent reuse, and progressive refresh.

The derive_plan_material_pin_health helper aggregates target pin status by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current) and reports legacy-unpinned only for wholly absent pins, with enforcement controlling whether drift/missing/malformed become terminal verdicts or remain advisory.

On full LLM review, the pre-LLM related_material snapshot from PlanRelationSnapshot is threaded through sidecar.emit and build_payload with additive reviewed_related_material field in plan_review_result_v2 format, enabling re-sign recovery to validate pinned state without a certified attestation.

Re-sign recovery reads reviewed_related_material from the sidecar, derives pin health with current enforcement, and refuses to sign if drift or missing targets are found and enforcement is enabled, while disabled enforcement remains advisory.

The compute_validity extension with PlanValidityProfile.DEFAULT, CLOSE, and DRIFT_REFRESH allows drift_refresh_candidate to delegate signature, kind, registry, own-material, and pin checks while retaining only code-drift qualification inline, and enables future close policy to disable only code freshness.

The optional enforce_plan_material_pins configuration uses key-local fail-open semantics (catching ConfigError, logging structured warning plan_material_pin_config_unreadable, returning false) so existing projects remain valid while enforcement can be incrementally enabled.
